name: draw
description: A strictly minimal diagramming tool with precise, programmable geometry: a deterministic, center-origin grid that renders headlessly to SVG. The server-held document is drivable by a human or an agent over REST, one writer at a time, and pushes to Google Slides as native editable shapes rather than an image.
